(Chance: 20%) No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of spells (Chance: 10%) :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== It uses the [[Elemental Sword]] [[skin]]. This skin is normally exclusive to [[sword]]s, although in this case it works as a wand. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons. All other Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic, or Water Magic wands deal [[lightning damage]], [[earth damage]], [[fire damage]], or [[cold damage]] respectively, not chaos damage. ==Notes== *Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Wand]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]] [[Category:Weapons with irregular skins]]
